sleep.heldHint: Put to sleep by an operator or a schedule: requests do not wake it
sleep.someHeldHint: Some replicas were put to sleep by an operator or a schedule: a request wakes only the others
sleep.releaseHoldDone: Requests now wake it: it stays asleep until one arrives
sleep.releaseHoldFailed: Could not let requests wake it: {{detail}}
sleep.partialWoken: Woke {{woken}}; {{refused}} could not fit back on their cards
sleep.waitStarted: Waiting for room: the wake follows when the GPUs free up
sleep.yieldStarted: Putting {{names}} to sleep; the wake follows once there is room. A request wakes them again.
sleep.yieldStartedHeld: {{names}} never yield by policy and stay asleep: requests do not wake them, wake them by hand.

refused.title: Not enough GPU memory to wake
refused.yieldHeld: {{occupants}} will sleep. Those that share their GPUs by a yield policy are woken by a request; those that never yield stay asleep until someone wakes them by hand (or a schedule does).
refused.hint: Waiting wakes what fits now and wakes the rest when the GPUs free up (it gives up after {{limit}}). Putting the occupants to sleep frees the GPUs first; if an occupant cannot sleep, nothing is changed.
refused.heldOutside: A process outside the platform holds the GPU

waiting.hint: The server wakes the sleepers when their GPUs can take them back, and gives up after {{limit}}.

sleepMode.intro: Choose what happens to requests the engine is still serving.
sleepMode.waitDetail: New requests are refused while the engine sleeps; in-flight ones complete. A long generation delays the sleep accordingly.
sleepMode.abortDetail: Clients with a request in progress get an error immediately.
sleepMode.wakeOnRequest: Wake it when a request arrives
sleepMode.wakeOnRequestOn: The gateway holds a request and wakes it, so it can take turns on the GPUs with other deployments by its yield policy.
sleepMode.wakeOnRequestOff: It stays asleep: requests get 503 until someone wakes it by hand (or a schedule does).

delete.forceDescription: Confirm that remote instances are already shut down. Running containers or cloud resources must be cleaned up separately.

detail.title: Deployment Details

restart.strategyRolling: One replica at a time (the others keep serving)
restart.rollingDescription: Each replica drains, finishing the requests it holds, while its replacement starts; the next one goes only once every replica serves again. Every replica gets its retry budget back.
restart.confirmDescription: The deployment will be unavailable until every instance is ready again: instances are stopped and started together, not rotated one at a time. Every replica gets its retry budget back.

retry.exhausted: A replica stopped being rebuilt after {{attempts}} failed attempts: {{reason}}

edit.help: Applies to replicas started from now on. Running replicas stay where they are; restart one to move it.
edit.nodesHelp: Leave empty to let any matching node run a replica. One node also keeps the GPU indexes the deployment was created with.
edit.labelsHelp: key=value; several values of one key are alternatives.

retry.exhausted: {{role}} instance {{index}} ({{node}}) failed {{attempts}} times and is no longer retried: {{reason}}

replica.autoHint: The platform picks every replica's {{nnodes}} nodes. Set the count; for new replicas you may name the nodes to start on first, and the rest are scheduled automatically. Shrinking removes the newest replicas first.
replica.unitsHint: Each replica runs on {{nnodes}} nodes: the leader serves, the others are followers. Two replicas cannot be led from one node.

suggest.added: Suggested on {{network}} ({{arch}}): {{nodes}}. Check it, then save.
suggest.none: No group of {{ranks}} nodes can take another replica: of {{nodes}} nodes, {{busy}} lack {{per_rank}} free GPU(s), {{unmet}} do not satisfy the requirements, {{cordoned}} are cordoned, {{offline}} are offline, {{no_network}} have no compute network; the largest group sharing a network and GPU architecture has {{largest}}.

replica.restartDescription: Its instances are replaced; the other replicas keep serving. It costs the replica no retry.
replica.drain: Drain first: finish the requests it holds while the replacement starts
replica.removeConfirm: Remove this replica? It finishes its requests first, then stops.
replica.followerHint: A follower rank: it is restarted, removed, slept and woken with its replica's leader.

placeOn.label: Nodes to start on first

refused.cordoned: Node {{node}} is cordoned and takes no new replicas.

refused.no_room: Node {{node}} has no room for a new replica: {{detail}}
refused.no_group: Node {{node}} cannot be part of a group of nodes that takes the new replica now.

imageMismatch.label: Image differs from the other replicas

preparation.noAutoRetry: Nothing retries this copy automatically; start it again when the cause is fixed.

unitsPlacement.label: Placement
unitsPlacement.autoHint: The platform picks a unit's nodes and cards whenever it starts, keeping its last nodes while they still fit.
unitsPlacement.manualHint: The nodes are fixed: the platform does not pick other ones for a unit.
unitsPlacement.confirmAuto: From now on the platform picks a unit's nodes and cards when the unit starts. The cards pinned to PD units are cleared. Nothing restarts now.
unitsPlacement.confirmManual: The nodes each unit has now are fixed and the platform no longer re-picks them automatically. Nothing restarts now.

scale.autoNote: Nodes left empty are scheduled automatically.
scale.rankSlotAria: Node of rank {{rank}} of new replica {{index}}
scale.prefixHint: Name nodes from the first rank on: a rank can be named only after the ranks before it.

cause.idle: after {{idle}} without requests (auto sleep when not preempted)
cause.resume: once the GPUs it gave up were free again

preempt.idle: to give its GPUs to {{who}} under its yield policy, after sitting idle for the idle time
preempt.rank: to give its GPUs to {{who}}, which ranks higher, under its yield policy
preempt.turn: to give its GPUs to {{who}}, whose turn it is in the time slice
preempt.abort: ; requests in flight were cut off

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.hint: Standing orders that run on their own at a set time. Each occurrence runs once; a manual order given in between is not overridden. A new or edited order fires from its next occurrence.
schedule.noActions: This deployment can neither sleep nor change its replica count on a schedule:
schedule.timezoneHint: Leave empty for the server's time zone, or give an IANA name such as Asia/Shanghai.
schedule.roleHint: A PD deployment scales each role with its own count; the order sets the count of the role you pick.

schedulingPolicy.title: Scheduling policy
schedulingPolicy.help: See the docs "Use the Scheduling Center" (schedule, yield policy) and "Reschedule on Node Loss" for details.

yieldPolicy.title: Yield policy
yieldPolicy.hint: When several sleepable deployments share GPUs, the yield policy decides who gives way to whom. A request for a deployment the platform put to sleep is held while it wakes, instead of failing with 503.
yieldPolicy.notSleepable: Sleep mode is not enabled for this deployment: it can only never yield automatically.
yieldPolicy.singleNodeOnly: A multi-node or PD deployment can only never yield automatically.
yieldPolicy.saveFailed: Failed to save the yield policy: {{detail}}
yieldPolicy.idleNeighbours: It shares GPUs with {{names}}, and all of them yield when idle: while both are busy neither gives way, and the other's requests are held until they time out. To take turns, switch to yield on a turn.

description.never: Never gives up its GPU memory and compute; for always-on services
description.idle: Gives up its GPU memory and compute when idle and a model sharing its cards needs them; for online workloads
description.timeslice: Gives up its GPU memory and compute when idle or its turn is over and a model sharing its cards needs them; for several models taking turns
description.anytime: Gives up its GPU memory and compute at once to a higher-priority deployment that needs them; for batch and offline work

field.unfinished: When yielding, requests not yet finished

help.idle_sec: Yields after this long without a user request (health checks do not count) while another deployment waits for the GPUs.
help.max_serve_sec: When sharing GPUs with other yield-on-a-turn deployments, each turn serves at most this long before giving way.
help.hold_max_sec: While the deployment is asleep or has yielded, a request is held at most this long waiting for the wake, then fails.

sleepLevel.auto: Automatic (L1 first, L2 when host memory cannot hold the weights)

dictionary.failed: Failed to load the yield policy options: {{detail}}

error.invalid_value: The value of "{{field}}" is not valid.

catalogTemplate.title: Save as inference template
catalogTemplate.testing: Testing the API and writing the template from what the deployment runs…
catalogTemplate.failed: This deployment cannot be saved as a template
catalogTemplate.verified: Every tested operation answered. The template is {{model}} / {{spec}}.
catalogTemplate.notVerified: A tested operation failed, so this template cannot be saved. The YAML is shown for troubleshooting.
catalogTemplate.noOperations: The model declares no operations, so nothing was tested.

check.notTested: not tested (slow or costly to test; the YAML says so)

catalogTemplate.notes: What the template states and what is missing

note.verified_on: Verified on {{count}} × {{gpu}}; the template matches only this card model.
note.kv_bytes_missing: No KV cost per token for {{engine}}: the deploy form will show no token capacity until a reviewer computes it from config.json.
note.model_config_missing: The model's config.json was not available, so memory estimation has no model shape.
note.placement_omitted: No placement: the deployment ran on {{gpu_count}} card(s) with {{gpu_memory_mib}} MiB each; scheduling decides the card count.
note.vram_limit: The deployment ran under a dGPU memory limit of {{vram_limit_mib}} MiB per card. That is this deployment's choice, not written as a requirement.
note.env_excluded: The deployment's own environment variables were left out: {{keys}}.
note.parameters_dropped: Settings that no engine flag carries were left out: {{keys}}.
note.container_overrides_omitted: Mounts and docker arguments describe one host and were left out.

reason.not_running: The deployment is not running, or none of its instances is running. Start it, then save it as a template.
reason.distributed: Multi-node deployments cannot be saved as a template yet.
reason.pd: PD disaggregated deployments cannot be saved as a template yet.
reason.no_gpu_facts: The running instance is not bound to specific cards, so the cards it was tested on are unknown.
reason.template_assets: The source template carries packaged files, which one YAML document cannot hold. Edit the template in the template editor instead.
reason.components: The source template uses component models, which one YAML document cannot resolve. Edit the template in the template editor instead.
reason.weights_not_public: The weights come from a local directory or a URL that nobody else can download.
reason.revision_unpinned: The weight revision is a branch name, not a commit. Pin the model to a commit and deploy again.
reason.revisions_differ: The model's copies resolved to different commits. Pin the model to one commit and deploy again.
reason.template_missing: The template this deployment was created from has been deleted.
reason.model_missing: The deployment's model has been deleted.
reason.command_overridden: The deployment replaced the engine command, so its launch cannot be written as template arguments.
reason.launch_changed: The saved configuration or running instance changed. Restart the deployment to apply its configuration, then try again.
reason.launch_snapshot_missing: The running instance has no complete launch snapshot that can be verified. Restart it with this server version, then try again.
reason.heterogeneous_gpus: The instance uses different GPU models. One tested-card selector cannot describe this combination.

catalogTemplate.envHint: They often hold tokens and host paths. Tick only the ones the model needs and that hold no secret, then rebuild.
catalogTemplate.saveNeedsAdmin: Saving into the catalog needs an administrator. Download the YAML and the test record to share them.
